market.question: Will Natural Gas (NG) hit (LOW) $2.60 in May?

assessment.reasoning: NG futures are at $2.72-2.86 with reports of a recent 1.5-year low and weakness from above-normal spring temps and high storage. Reaching $2.60 needs only ~4% drop. With weak demand backdrop and 24 days left in May, base rate is fairly high. May already have been touched given 1.5-year low report.
data_sources: bloomberg.com US Natural Gas Futures Fall May 5 2026
assessment.key_uncertainty: Whether $2.60 has already been touched in early May; production curtailments could push NG higher.
